evidence.section: Gene array analysis of whole-blood and VaxDesign samples.
evidence.quote: The biotinylated cRNA was hybridized onto Illumina Human RefSeq-8 BeadChips v2 (Montreal and Lausanne samples) or v3 (VaxDesign samples) at 58°C for 20 h and quantified using Illumina BeadStation 500GX scanner and Illumina BeadStudio v3 software.

The expression of 43 genes, which were chosen according to our microarray results and to biomedical literature, was analyzed on samples obtained at day 0 and 7 after vaccination from the Montreal and Lausanne cohorts.

evidence.section: In vitro infection of immature DCs with YF17D.
evidence.quote: After 24 and 48 h, supernatants were collected and analyzed using an IL-1β ELISA kit (BD).

CFSE labeling.readouts: T cell proliferative responses to YF17D-derived peptide pools measured by CFSE dilution

evidence.quote: PBMCs from vaccinated volunteers were labeled with CFSE (Invitrogen), as previously described ( 64 ).

BD Th1/Th2 CBA array.readouts: levels of IL-2, IL-4, IL-5, IL-10, IFN-γ, and TNF in PBMC supernatants

evidence.quote: The BD Th1/Th2 CBA array (BD) was used to measure levels of IL-2, IL-4, IL-5, IL-10, IFN-γ, and TNF in PBMCs supernatants, as suggested by the manufacturer.

evidence.section: Flow cytometric analysis of IFN-γ/IL-2–producing activated CD4 T cells.
evidence.quote: To assess the cytokine production ability of YF17D-specific helper T cells, 2 million PBMCs from vaccinated subjects (day 14 and 28) were stimulated for 6 h with YF17D-derived peptide pools, in the presence of Brefeldin A (Sigma-Aldrich), and then stained with anti-CD8 and -CD4 antibodies.

CD4 + T cell stimulation assay.readouts: intracellular IFN-γ, IL-5, IL-13, and CD154 expression in stimulated CD4 positive T cells

evidence.quote: The T cells and APCs were co-cultured for 7 h, stained with CD4 antibody, permeabilized, and labeled intracellularly with anti–IFN-γ, –IL-5, –IL-13, and -CD154 antibodies.

Multiplex cytokine analysis.readouts: cytokine production in culture supernatants measured on a bead-based multiplex reader

evidence.quote: At the time the lymphocytes were harvested from DC/T cell co-cultures, the supernatants were also collected and stored frozen until analyzed for cytokine production using the Beadlyte human 22-plex Multi-cytokine Detection System (Millipore) on a Bio-Plex reader (Bio-Rad Laboratories).

flow cytometry.readouts: frequencies of Ki67-positive proliferating leukocyte subsets

evidence.quote: To do so, PBMCs from 6 volunteers, sampled at day 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, and 28 after vaccination, were stained with anti-Ki67and other specific antibodies to identify, by flow cytometry, different cell subsets that are actively proliferating.
